title: Affine conjugation of the conormal base-change map to the ideal cotangent map
statement: Let i:Z→X and i':Z'→X' be closed immersions in a commutative cartesian square with g:X→X' and f:Z→Z' [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-conormal-functorial], [def-pc-fibre-product]. Let c be its canonical conormal morphism. Fix affine opens U of X and U' of X' with U contained in g inverse image of U'. Put A=Γ(X',U'), B=Γ(X,U), with A-algebra structure on B induced by g, and J=i'.ker.ideal U'. There exist equivalences eS from the sections of f* C_(Z'/X') over i inverse image of U to B tensor_A J.Cotangent, and eT from the sections of C_(Z/X) there to (J.map(includeRight:A→B tensor_A A)).Cotangent, such that for every source section s, eT(c(s))=Ideal.tensorCotangentHom A B J (eS(s)). Cotangent means J/J². Only this affine section comparison is asserted; there is no flatness assumption and no assertion of surjectivity, injectivity or global invertibility.

source.place: Morphisms, Lemma 0473 (morphisms-lemma-conormal-functorial-flat), case of closed immersions, with its proof; the ideal of the base-changed closed immersion is Schemes, Lemma 01JU (schemes-lemma-fibre-product-immersion) (1)

proof.text: Obtain the normalized additive source coordinate eS from [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-conormal-affine-source-coordinates]. This isolates only the affine tensor/quotient construction, without a morphism c.

Construct the target coordinate explicitly. IsPullback.of_isLimit and isoPullback identify i with the pullback projection up to an isomorphism. Kernel invariance and Mathlib ker_fst_of_isClosedImmersion give i.ker=i'.ker.comap g; [lem-pc-ideal-sheaf-comap-affine-extension] computes its ideal as JB. The B-algebra multiplication isomorphism B tensor_A A ≃ B carries J.map(includeRight) to JB. Ideal.mapCotangent for this algebra isomorphism and its inverse give mutually inverse cotangent maps, verified on ideal representatives using toCotangent_surjective. Compose its inverse with the inverse of [lem-weil-pbc-affine-conormal-sections] for i to obtain eT. Linearity and tensorCotangentHom_tmul give its normalization on b times an immersion-unit ideal section.

Apply the affine clause of [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-conormal-functorial] to the ideal representative of a. Naturality of pushforwardComp followed by pushforwardCongr lets c commute past the composite source unit; naturality of c lets it commute past restriction. Thus c sends the source unit to the i-unit of an ideal section whose ambient value is g(a). Hom.app_smul and the two coordinate normalizations give the comparison on b tensor class(a). Every cotangent element has an ideal representative, and every ideal element has an ideal-sheaf section by range_toModulesι_app. TensorProduct.induction_on, using additivity in the zero and sum cases, extends the equation to every tensor. Substitute eS(s) and use eS.symm_apply_apply to conclude the original unchanged statement.

lean.statement:
theorem closedImmersion_conormal_affine_base_change_comparison
    {X Z X' Z' : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X) (i' : Z' ⟶ X')
    [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsClosedImmersion i']
    (g : X ⟶ X') (f : Z ⟶ Z') (h : i ≫ g = f ≫ i')
    (hc : IsLimit (PullbackCone.mk i f h))
    (c : (tensorPullback f).obj ((tensorPullback i').obj i'.ker.toModules) ⟶
      (tensorPullback i).obj i.ker.toModules)
    (hcanonical : c = Classical.choose ((Classical.choose_spec
      (closedImmersion_conormal_functorial i i' g f h).2).2))
    (U : X.affineOpens) (U' : X'.affineOpens) (H : U.1 ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1) :
    letI : Algebra Γ(X', U'.1) Γ(X, U.1) := (g.appLE U'.1 U.1 H).hom.toAlgebra
    ∃ (eS : Γ((tensorPullback f).obj ((tensorPullback i').obj i'.ker.toModules),
          i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) ≃
        Γ(X, U.1) ⊗[Γ(X', U'.1)] (i'.ker.ideal U').Cotangent)
      (eT : Γ((tensorPullback i).obj i.ker.toModules, i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) ≃
        ((i'.ker.ideal U').map (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom :
          Γ(X', U'.1) →+* Γ(X, U.1) ⊗[Γ(X', U'.1)] Γ(X', U'.1))).Cotangent),
      ∀ s, eT (c.app (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) s) =
        (i'.ker.ideal U').tensorCotangentHom Γ(X', U'.1) Γ(X, U.1) (eS s)
